Adding the files yourself is quicker, and the checks then tell you directly if something is off:
[Add file -> Upload files](https://github.com/Shirowwww/Achievement-Watcher-Next/upload/main/docs/gallery/community)
in `docs/gallery/community/`. Two files with the same name, one `.awpreset` and one picture. The
guide is [preset-gallery.md](https://shirowwww.github.io/Achievement-Watcher-Next/preset-gallery.html).

Use this issue instead if you would rather not open a pull request.

## Attach

- [ ] The `.awpreset`, exported from Settings, Presets, Export.
- [ ] A picture of the popup: PNG, WebP or JPEG, at most 500 KB.

GitHub does not accept `.awpreset` as an attachment: rename it to `preset.awpreset.zip` or put it
in a zip before dragging it in.

## Confirm

- [ ] I made this preset, and every picture, font and sound inside it is mine to share.
- [ ] I am happy for it to be published under CC BY 4.0.

**Credited as** (leave blank to use your GitHub name):

**Profile link** (optional):

> A preset is HTML and CSS. It is read with the app's own code before it is listed, and the gallery
> never runs it: the site shows your picture, and the app renders the preset in its sandboxed
> notification window.
